facts.summary: Aria trial missed primary and secondary endpoints; other studies halted, workforce cut · Phase 2/3 · PRAX-114 in major depressive disorder · not yet approved

evidence.summary: the Phase 2/3 Aria Study evaluating the efficacy and safety of PRAX-114 for monotherapy treatment of major depressive disorder (“MDD”) did not achieve statistical significance on the primary endpoint
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: did not achieve statistical significance on the primary endpoint of change from baseline in the 17-item Hamilton Depression Rating Scale total score at Day 15, or on any secondary endpoints
evidence.safety: The Company is stopping enrollment in its Phase 2 study evaluating PRAX-114 for the treatment of post-traumatic stress disorder, and intends to review the safety data once available.
